name: prompting-wizard
description: Learn prompting through your everyday work: practice, short lessons and Learning Cards, an optional 30-lesson course, and a review of your past chats.

interface.longDescription: Finish your work, then choose practice, an example or a short lesson, and keep accepted evidence in a portable Learning Card. Take the optional 30-lesson course, or review your past chats with the same provider to see where prompts cost you turns. In ChatGPT and Claude the everyday coaching is a pilot; local course storage and pw history need Claude Code or Codex.
defaultPrompt: Use Prompting Wizard to teach me through my work; no interview.
